messages:
marie_cs: Quick update on Willow renewal — procurement pushed back: they want to split billing across two legal entities and move to a 9‑month term. Procurement requires a vendor number and PO before signing. Legal needs to confirm amendment language. Sharing draft SOW: https://app.redwood/sow/willow/draft

devon_csm: Noted. They also asked for a seat ramp plan for the 9‑mo term. I'll attach the enablement plan to the contract thread.

kevin_sales: We can do 9‑mo but pricing needs to be pro‑rated. Proposal: keep list price, apply 25% proration to cover partial year. Is that acceptable to finance/legal?

sam_legal: I'll review the SOW and the proposed billing annex. Two entities usually calls for either two contracts or one master + billing annex. Prefer master + annex to avoid duplicate signatures. Uploading comments now.

anya_billing: Need the vendor numbers, tax IDs, and billing addresses. Also confirm which entity will own the committed seats. If split, we'll need two invoice lines.

marie_cs: Procurement provided vendor numbers: `WIL-4567` (Willow Inc. US) and `WIL-EU2` (Willow EU Ltd) but legal flagged the IDs don't match the org names on their corp docs. @kevin_sales can you confirm the source?

kevin_sales: Confirmed — those codes came from their procurement rep Claire Nguyen. I'll loop her into this thread and get scanned corp docs + PO sample. Doing that this afternoon.

devon_csm: Enablement note: entity B needs 10 sandbox seats for ATO testing and SSO validation. Can we provision next week?

eng_ops_bot: deploy-bot: sandbox org created — `willow-sandbox-B` (id: `sbx-789`). Seats provisioned as placeholders; license assignment required by billing.

marie_cs: Sign path I'm proposing: 1) Legal approves amendment, 2) Sales finalizes pricing & PO term (net60?), 3) Renewals sends DocuSign to authorized signer. Who is the authorized signer on their side per the corp docs?

willow_procurement: Claire (CFO) is the authorized signer. They will issue a PO once the contract reflects `net60` and includes the PO# field. Prefers ACH payment.

finance_oliver: Finance can accept `net60` conditionally — we will treat it as contingent revenue and delay recognition until payment clears. Also propose adding a 1.5% processing fee for extended terms. Approve if vendor code mapping to our billing system is clean.

marie_cs: Noted. I'll draft a confirmation email to Claire summarizing: 9‑month term, proration at 25%, net60 with 1.5% fee, master contract + billing annex, and PO flow. Also want to capture product feedback: they said onboarding docs were helpful but want clearer token budgeting examples.

devex_rachel: Thanks — I'll add a short "token budgeting + prompt examples" page to the docs backlog and aim to ship a first draft by EOD Friday.

renewal-bot: Reminder: Renewal target date 2026-04-15. Open tasks: legal review (sam_legal), confirm PO + corp docs (kevin_sales), finalize billing mapping (anya_billing), assign sandbox licenses (billing), docs update (devex_rachel).

devon_csm: I'll follow up with Willow procurement at 14:00 PST and post updates here.

marie_cs: Thanks all — looping in Claire now. :thumbsup:
